# network.find_canton { #cflowdist.network.find_canton }

```python
network.find_canton(tracer)
```

Find the canton name and code for the location of the tracer using the swisstopo Web API.
Raises a ValueError if the location falls outside Switzerland.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description                                                                      |
|--------|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[str, str\] | (canton_name_for_calendar, canton_code), e.g. `('Vaud', 'VD')`, `Zurich', 'ZH')` |
